mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window or correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market and robust economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 3.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has a Rank IC below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or the joint signal (both rising) produces positive returns in less than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 4.0%), the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain activity, which reduces corporate profits and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 95.0, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A lower level of industrial production indicates reduced economic activity and declining corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 60-day SPX returns is above -0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS * RSAFS) has a Rank IC below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or the joint signal (both rising) produces positive returns in less than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), rising wage pressures lead to higher inflation and aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.
